rules.statement: Never commit `PLAN.md`. It is a local, gitignored handoff file between the planner and the executor.
rules.why: PLAN.md is local working state for the plan-then-execute workflow and must never be committed, staged or pushed.
rules.check: Flag any diff or commit that adds or changes `PLAN.md`.

rules.statement: Never commit secrets, including `.env` files or the contents of the repository-root `secrets/` folder.
rules.why: Secrets must never enter the repository or a prompt. Those paths are gitignored for that reason.
rules.check: Look for added `.env` files, files under the root `secrets/` folder, or hard-coded credentials, keys or tokens in the diff.

rules.statement: Save text files as UTF-8 without a BOM, with LF line endings, and follow `.editorconfig`.
rules.why: This is the repository-wide encoding and formatting convention.
rules.check: Flag files that start with a UTF-8 BOM, files with CRLF line endings, or formatting that goes against `.editorconfig`.

rules.statement: Do not add a `Co-authored-by:` trailer naming an AI agent, a `Claude-Session:` trailer, or a "Generated with" line to commits or pull requests.
rules.why: Commits and pull requests record the people who wrote them. A commit-msg hook and a CI check enforce this.
rules.check: Look in commit messages and PR descriptions for AI co-author trailers, session trailers or generated-with lines.

rules.statement: Do not edit files owned by the project template (`.template/`, `.template-version`, `.githooks/commit-msg`, `CLAUDE.md`, `build/ProjectTemplate.props`, `.github/instructions/csharp.instructions.md`, `.claude/rules/csharp.md`, the generated commands, prompts, skills and agents, and `.copier-answers.yml`). Override rules in `AGENTS.md` or in project instruction files instead.
rules.why: Template updates replace these files and throw away any local edits.
rules.check: Flag diffs that change template-owned files, unless the change comes from a template update.

rules.statement: Change build settings in `Directory.Build.props` after its import of `build/ProjectTemplate.props`, not in the template props file and not before the import.
rules.why: Settings placed after the import override the template's shared defaults and survive template updates.
rules.check: Flag new MSBuild properties added to `build/ProjectTemplate.props`, or placed before its import in `Directory.Build.props`, when they are meant to override a shared setting.

rules.statement: Put package versions in `<PackageVersion>` items in `Directory.Packages.props`. `<PackageReference>` items in project files must not have a `Version`.
rules.why: The repository uses central package management, and a version on a PackageReference fails the build with NU1008.
rules.check: Flag `<PackageReference ... Version=...>` in .csproj files, and new packages that have no matching `<PackageVersion>` entry.

rules.statement: Add every new project to the solution at the repository root.
rules.why: Then `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` at the root cover every project.
rules.check: When a diff adds a new .csproj, check that the root solution file is updated to include it.
